author: David Bombal
description:
How much information can someone find from a photo of your car?

OSINT expert Mishaal Khan explains how something as simple as a license plate can become a starting point for an investigation. By connecting public records, vehicle information, company registrations and other openly available data, an investigator can potentially build a surprisingly detailed picture of someone’s identity and pattern of life.

This is why seemingly harmless information you post online can matter far more than you think.

#OSINT #CyberSecurity #Privacy
title: Your License Plate Reveals More Than You Think
